thread:
alex: heads-up — around 01:12 we saw a short burst of ECC corrections followed by a couple Xid 43s in us-east-2 on gpunode-03. DCGM exporter alerts flooded but our current rules either spam or silence too much. want a quick tuning + escalation plan.

morgan: saw the same. traces show kernel driver log around the same time. looks like transient thermal throttling plus a bad retry path. not convinced we should replace hw yet.

priya: can you paste the DCGM metric deltas? rough counts pls — ECC corrected vs uncorrectable vs Xid.

alex: quick numbers from the scraped metrics: "dcgm_ecc_corrected_total" +34 over 5m, "dcgm_ecc_uncorrected_total" +1, "dcgm_xid_errors_total" +2 (same GPU index).

ken: thanks. pattern = multiple corrected ECC then occasional uncorrected + xid. that's the classic 'warming up noisy card' pattern we've seen. propose: tighten alerting to detect bursts and require correlation (ECC burst + Xid within window) before paging.

sam: agree. current rule pages on any ECC > threshold in 1m which is noisy. proposal: windowed burst + minimum occurrences + escalation levels.

priya: +1. also add a recording rule to surface node+gpu pair rates so we can graph long tail.

alex: here's a draft prometheus alert rule to discuss:

```yaml
alert: GPU_ECC_XID_CORRELATED_BURST
expr: (increase(dcgm_ecc_corrected_total[10m]) > 20 and increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[10m]) > 0)
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Correlated ECC/Xid burst on {{ $labels.node }}:gpu{{ $labels.gpu_index }}"
  runbook: "https://go/runbooks/gpu-ecc-xid"
```

morgan: that looks fine. maybe split severity: if ecc_corrected > 50 in 10m -> warn, if +xid -> page. also only page if uncorrected > 0 or xid > 0.

ken: small tweak: use `increase()` for both but add a grouping label: `by (node, gpu_index)` so we don't aggregate across cards. otherwise big clusters will look noisy.

priya: agree — and add a suppression window for driver updates/rollouts. we saw a rolling driver deploy last week that tripped a lot of noisy alerts. maybe annotate CI deploys so rule can skip when node has label `driver:updating`.

alex: nice. sample recording rule I want on dashboards:

```yaml
record: job:gpu:ecc_xid_burst_rate:10m
expr: sum by(node, gpu_index) (increase(dcgm_ecc_corrected_total[10m]) + increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[10m]))
```

sam: for triage/playbook: short steps we can put in runbook: 
1) Cordon node and drain GPU workloads on affected node (if more than 1 card impacted)
2) Run `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` + `dmesg | grep -i xid` and upload to oblog
3) Snapshot DCGM metrics `curl http://localhost:9400/metrics > /tmp/dcgm-metrics-snap.txt`
4) If uncorrectable ECC or Xid > 3 in 1h -> escalate to hardware team to schedule RMA
5) If only corrected ECC bursts and no xid -> monitor, add to night sweep list

morgan: add step 0: check if driver rollout or thermal event was active in last hour. we have a deploy-bot annotation in node metadata.

ken: escalation matrix (draft):
- Sev P0: uncorrectable ECC >=1 + Xid >=1 on any single GPU -> immediate page + action: cordon + RMA request
- Sev P1: Xid >=3 in 1h or uncorrected ECC >3 -> page to oncall, schedule immediate diagnostic window
- Sev P2: corrected ECC burst (e.g., corrected >50 in 24h) with no xid -> annotate and add to repeating maintenance queue

priya: let's also capture metrics for corrected vs uncorrected ratio in a single panel; if corrected ratio climbs but uncorrected remains zero it's noisy but not yet critical.

alex: ops items for rules: 
- Add `by(node,gpu_index)` grouping to existing dcgm ECC/Xid alerts
- Move from 1m threshold -> 10m sliding window with `for: 5m` to avoid microbursts
- Add suppression if node has label `driver:updating` or annotation `maintenance=true`
- Create recording rule `job:gpu:ecc_xid_burst_rate:10m` and use it in alert expr

sam: one more: add an annotation to alerts that includes `serial`, `gpu_index` and link to `https://infra.example.com/nodes/{{ $labels.node }}/gpu/{{ $labels.gpu_index }}` so oncall can immediately jump to the node view.

morgan: testing plan: deploy rule to staging cluster, run a synthetic generator that increments `dcgm_ecc_corrected_total` and `dcgm_xid_errors_total` for a single gpu label to verify we only page on real correlations.

alex: i'll open a PR with proposed rules + runbook changes and a simple python synthetic exporter for our staging scrape. assigning to @morgan for review and @priya for runbook wording.

sre-bot: Alert created: GPU_ECC_XID_CORRELATED_BURST testing ticket #INC-2134 (link: https://tickets/INC-2134)

priya: thanks all — aim to have PR + staging test by EOD tomorrow. i'll update runbook and include the exact `kubectl` drain/cordon commands and artifact locations. :thumbsup:

ken: nice work. once merged let's schedule a 30m smoke window during low traffic to watch for false negatives/positives.

alex: agreed. closing this thread after PR is up. thanks everyone.
